messages:
Emma (CS): Quick alert — Silverfin account activity has dropped: embeddings requests down ~72% week-over-week. Renewal in 6 weeks. Procurement moved to Maya, and they're trialing VectorShift (competitor).
Luis (AE): ugh. Any errors or billing? Last touch was with ML lead who left.
Emma (CS): No billing issues. Error spike last Fri for embed jobs: timeouts & retries. Linked perf dashboard: https://redwood.app/accounts/silverfin/usage
Raj (SRE): Found pattern: embed batch timeouts when payloads >50 vectors. traceback: "batch_send_timeout" at 60s. Possible batching TTL misconfig + large payloads.
Nora (Solutions Eng): They mentioned switching to faster float16 quantized model on competitor. Also asked for migration docs for model parity.
Maya (Procurement): timeline: RFP closes in 3w. Need clear ask: proof of improved embed throughput or they'll proceed.
Emma (CS): Proposed: (1) short 2-week dedicated perf pilot focusing on embeds, (2) SE config to lower batch size + enable async streaming, (3) perf report for procurement, (4) customer survey about feature gaps. Thoughts?
Luis (AE): I'm ok offering a limited pilot if we can show measurable throughput gain. Need legal/discount bounds.
Raj (SRE): Can demo config in staging today. If we reduce max_batch to 25 and enable prefix caching, should cut p95 by ~40% for their payloads. I'll post numbers within 4h.
Nora (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare a step-byp migration checklist and a sample script to convert embeddings pipeline. Will attach to the perf report.
Emma (CS): Action owners: Luis — commercial terms; Maya — procurement constraints; Raj & Nora — perf trial + docs; Emma — outreach & survey. triage-bot set reminder for renewal-check in 3w.
triage-bot: reminder set: renewal-check-in at 1771730000.
Luis (AE): Booking a procurement sync Fri 10am PT. I'll invite Maya + their procurement.
Emma (CS): Thanks all. Keep updates here. :pray:
